key_insight: Decision2Care performed diagnostic work-ups without generating text, recording candidate actions, probabilities, and execution rules for audit.
clinical_relevance: Auditable decision records could help clinicians examine how diagnostic assessments and treatment choices evolve.
method: Assigns probabilities to permitted electronic health record actions.
Uses fixed rules to execute the highest-probability action.
Tracks diagnostic options and probability changes throughout each work-up.
evidence_signal: Across records from 546 emergency admissions covering 12 diseases, diagnostic accuracy was 86.5% versus MIRA-v2’s 86.1%, with a median work-up time of 2.2 seconds versus 92–100 seconds.
watch_item: Record-based evaluation does not establish prospective clinical safety; high-confidence errors linked to imaging reports highlight sensitivity to input information.
paper_title: Auditable Clinical Support with Decision Agents
